artworks.title: Ornament with Two Sphinxes and a Winged Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.8 x 11.8 cm (3 1/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative grotesque design featuring fantastical creatures. The image shows a symmetrical arrangement with mythical beasts on either side, each having the upper body of a human and the lower body resembling that of a winged, leonine creature. In the center atop a decorative plinth, a seated winged figure holds a staff, framed by intricate tendrils and scrollwork. The style employs fine line work to create depth and texture, typical of detailed Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: The Dentist
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 x 7.5 cm (4 9/16 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: In this engraving, three figures are depicted. The central person is facing slightly to the side. A man on the left leans in, examining the central figure's mouth. The central figure appears distressed, while the woman on the right observes. Various tools and objects are scattered on a table in the background. The year "1523" and the letter 'L' are inscribed above the figures.

artworks.title: The Surgeon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One is seated and the other is kneeling in front of him. The seated man is holding a small object and using it on the kneeling man’s head. The seated person is wearing a detailed cap, a fur-trimmed coat, a beard, and spectacles. The kneeling man has short hair and his face looks somewhat expressive. He is dressed in a plain shirt and pants, with his hands raised near his chest. The background has a texture and the year "1524" is visible. There are some plain furnishings and a bowl on the side.

artworks.title: The Musicians
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.4 x 7.4 cm (4 1/2 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures sitting closely together. The person on the left is playing a stringed instrument similar to a lute, while the person on the right is playing a bowed string instrument. Both individuals have distinct facial features and are dressed in garments with hoods. The background includes sparse trees, a wooden fence, rocky ground, and scattered objects. The date "1524" is visible in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: The Old Woman with Grapes
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly person depicted from just below the shoulders and up, facing slightly to the left. The individual has pronounced facial features, with a broad nose and a serious expression. Their hair is not visible, as it is covered by a turban-like headpiece adorned with a layered, ruffled design. They are wearing layered clothing that includes a robe with a decorative collar, fastened with a round button. The person is holding a cluster of grapes delicately with both hands. The background consists of a finely detailed, textured pattern.

artworks.title: A Nobleman and a Lady Seated in a Landscape
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a pastoral setting. The drawing features two individuals sitting on rocky terrain, with a castle visible in the background on a hill amidst trees. The person on the left is draped in flowing robes and is looking down towards the other figure, while the person on the right extends an intricate goblet or chalice towards the first figure. The scene conveys a sense of narrative and interaction. The ground is uneven and rocky, while the castle suggests a distant, idyllic background.

artworks.title: Pallas Athene
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a contrapposto pose. They have a strong profile with defined facial features, styled hair, and are wearing draped clothing. One hand holds a spear while the other holds a shield. In the background, there is a rocky landscape with clouds in the sky and a floating banner or fabric.

artworks.title: Pyramus and Thisbe
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body depictions of people in a detailed scene. The person on the left is in a standing position, slightly bent at the knees, holding a sword pointed at the ground. This person has delicate facial features with their head slightly turned to the side, and long flowing hair with a headdress. They wear a flowing dress with billowing sleeves and fabric secured with tied sashes around the waist. The person is near a reclined man on the right, who is lying on a grassy area with one leg bent, and is dressed in a protective, armored outfit including padded sleeves and pants, with a cloak draping over one arm. His face is tilted upwards, and his long hair cascades over the ground. In the background to the left, an elegant fountain with statues and water streams is visible, and trees frame the scene on the right, with a dog sniffing the ground near the base of a tree. The setting appears to be an outdoor scene, possibly in a garden or park, with intricate detailing in both the figures and the surrounding landscape.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, in a slightly tilted pose. She has delicate facial features with closed or downcast eyes and wavy hair flowing past her shoulders. She wears a crown with floral motifs and a detailed garment with a high neckline, buttons, and intricate patterns. In her left hand, she holds a sword, while her right arm appears to be cradling a book. A wheel-like object is seen beside her. The background is plain, with textured etching marks around her, and a faint halo surrounds her head. The image has a subtle monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene in the Desert
Saint Francis of Assisi Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on the ground with their hands raised towards the sky. The person has a serene facial expression and a halo around their head. They are dressed in a long robe with sleeves, and a book and a skull are near them. Above the figure, there is a halo with a crucifixion scene, attached to a tree. The background features textured tree trunks in a forest setting.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing. He is dressed in a long cloak with a hood, holding an open book in his left hand and a walking stick in his right hand. There is a wooden structure with a bell on the left and a pig with a bell around its neck on the right. A halo-like illumination is depicted behind the man.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.description: The image depicts a person bound to a tree with hands tied above their head. Their facial features show a downward gaze, with long hair falling around their shoulders and a halo around their head. The person wears minimal clothing and several arrows pierce their torso. The surrounding landscape includes a tree stump, rocky terrain, sparse vegetation, and a sign hanging from a tree branch. The scene is rendered in a detailed, monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a seated elderly man with a long, bushy beard and a bald head, holding an open book. He is wearing a long, draped garment and is seated next to a lion. The background includes rugged, rocky terrain with possible vegetation.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist in the Desert
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on the ground, facing slightly to the right with his right arm extended in that direction. He has a full beard, mustache, and curly hair. He is wearing draped, classical-style clothing. A unicorn is lying down nearby. The background consists of a barren, rocky landscape with a bare tree to the left. The number "1513" is inscribed in the upper right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher at the Border of a River
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated on the ground with his legs crossed, leaning on a staff with his right hand. He has curly hair, a full beard, and is wearing a long robe. The background features rocky terrain, trees, and another figure on a path, as well as a body of water with a person on a small boat.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul with the Vernicle
artworks.description: The image shows three men in an ornate, classical style. Two men are visible from the upper torso up, holding a cloth displaying a third face. The man on the left faces right with wavy, shoulder-length hair and a thick beard, holding a key and a sword. The man on the right tilts his head slightly as he looks outward, with a full, long beard and hair. He holds a book and a stick-like object. The fabric they hold shows a serene face with thorns in the hair. The background features a textured surface and two columns. The image is rendered in a detailed line drawing style.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated individual from the knees up. The person is sitting on an animal, likely an ox, as they write on a scroll or a book resting on their knee. The individual has focused features, a furrowed brow, and closed lips, wearing a distinctive cap covering most of their hair with ear flaps hanging down. They are dressed in a long cloak with a hood, with exposed feet in simple footwear. A book is seen on the ground beside them. In the background, a lantern hangs from a bare tree branch, and the setting features a rugged, earthy terrain.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: The image shows two people by a well. One person, seated at the well, has long hair and a detailed halo above their head. They wear a long robe and are pointing with one hand. The other person is standing and holding a jug attached to a rope leading to the well. The background includes buildings and hills. The scene is depicted in an engraved style with strong lines and shading.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a large tree with a serpent wrapped around its trunk. In front of the tree, there are two figures interacting with the tree's fruits. In the background, there is architecture resembling a religious building, along with rolling hills and additional figures. The image is rendered in a detailed illustrative style.

artworks.title: Jael Killing Sisera
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing two figures engaged in a struggle, with one holding a weapon. In the background, another figure gestures towards them, while other figures in historical clothing are present. The setting includes a stone-walled room with shelves holding bottles and containers. The artwork is made with detailed line work resembling woodcut or engraving techniques, focusing on expression and posture to convey drama. The setting suggests a historical period like medieval or Renaissance.

artworks.title: Solomon's Idolatry
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a surreal scene. Figures are arranged around a large globe-like object. One figure is holding a torch emitting smoke, standing on an elevated platform. Cherub-like creatures with wings are struggling to move the spherical object. On the right, robed individuals are engaged in a ritual. The setting includes stylized cloud formations in the background. The art style features strong lines and detailed shading.

artworks.title: The Mouth of Truth
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in historical attire gathered around an animal. The illustration has intricate linework showing an assembly of figures with one person kneeling towards a large creature. The surrounding figures have varied poses, some gesturing while others seem contemplative. The background features stylized mountains. The scene appears to be set in a historical or narrative context rich in detail, depicting a moment possibly relating to ceremony or significance.

artworks.title: The Stragglers
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval procession with armored warriors carrying spears and banners marching. Some are on horses. The drawing features detailed garments and armors with flowing drapery and engravings, emphasizing movement. The mix of horsemen and infantry suggests a military parade. The artwork uses intricate linework and portrays a dense crowd.
